conventions.basis: ghat = g + C*1; index m = dim g denotes the scalar 1; g = span of super-symmetrised quadratics
conventions.bracket: [Z_i,Z_j]_gb = sum_k C[i][j][k] Z_k + kappa * sum_p gb_p sum_k G[p][i][j][k] Z_k
conventions.f_matrix: f[p][j] = sparse vector of f_{e_p}(Z_j) in the basis (phi_{ij} = f[p][j][i])
conventions.weights: [eps-coefficient, delta_1, ..., delta_n]; a+ has weight +eps, b_j^+ has weight +delta_j
conventions.cartan_relation: doc's H_1 = N + Hs_1, H_k = Hs_{k-1} - Hs_k (2<=k<=n), H_{n+1} = -Hs_n

structure_constants.format: [i, j, k, value] : [Z_i, Z_j]_0 = sum_k value Z_k

gamma.format: [p, i, j, k, value] : coefficient of gb_p in gamma(Z_i,Z_j) along Z_k (k = m is the scalar 1)

f.format: [p, i, j, value] : f_{e_p}(Z_j) = sum_i value Z_i  (odd map g -> g)

lambda_.format: [p, k, value] : lambda_{e_p}(Z_k) = value;  gamma(X,Y) - (delta f)(X,Y) = lambda([X,Y]_0) * 1

inner_odd_derivations.format: label Z, [i, j, value]: ad_Z(Z_j) = sum_i value Z_i; these span ker(delta) on odd 1-cochains
